description: This Java class defines a Spring MVC Controller for managing system configuration within an admin interface. It includes handler methods for displaying and saving system configuration settings, interacts with merchant configuration services, and sets up menu context for views.

classes.name: SystemConfigurationController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller handling system configuration admin functions such as display and save settings.

methods.name: displaySysyemConfgurations
methods.description: Handles GET requests to show current system configuration settings.

methods.name: saveSystemConfigurations
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save updated system configuration settings.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Configures menu context for the view, setting active menu items and current menu.
